notes.content: ABOUT THE MAJOR The Communication major provides courses that explore models of communication theory and application of theory in specific communication contexts. The major approaches the study of communication from a broad, liberal arts perspective that includes the historical, philosophical, and theoretical roots of communication. Courses provide necessary background for successful work and service in the public, private and religious sectors, as well as future graduate studies. TEACHER EDUCATION PROGRAM INFORMATION Students who are interested in applying for admission to the Teacher Education Program should refer to the Graduate School description of admissions requirements for the program and obtain academic advising from the program at least two semesters prior to completion of their degrees. **Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU** This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php .
notes.contentHtml:
ABOUT THE MAJOR

The Communication major provides courses that explore models of communication theory and application of theory in specific communication contexts. The major approaches the study of communication from a broad, liberal arts perspective that includes the historical, philosophical, and theoretical roots of communication. Courses provide necessary background for successful work and service in the public, private and religious sectors, as well as future graduate studies.


TEACHER EDUCATION PROGRAM INFORMATION

Students who are interested in applying for admission to the Teacher Education Program should refer to the Graduate School description of admissions requirements for the program and obtain academic advising from the program at least two semesters prior to completion of their degrees.


﻿**Agreement does not include all required courses for the major at FPU**

This agreement lists courses that are prerequisites or may be completed prior to transfer to satisfy major requirements. All transfer courses must be completed with a grade of C- or better, and students must complete a minimum of 18 units in the major at FPU. Please contact an academic advisor to discuss the recommended sequence of courses, including courses that may count for both GE and major requirements. To view the full degree requirements, please refer to the Undergraduate Catalog: https://catalog.fresno.edu/index.php.
